items.en: Saudi Bahri confirms two deaths after Monday oil tanker attack in Hormuz.

items.en: Qatar, Egypt, and Jordan denounce Iranian attacks on Arab neighbours.

items.en: Two Palestinians killed in Israeli drone strike in northern and central Gaza.

items.en: Russia reportedly assisting Iran covertly in developing advanced supersonic cruise missiles.
